name: otp-input
title: OTP Input
description: A multi-slot one-time-passcode input — keyboard navigation, paste distribution, masking, disabled, built on Base UI OTP Field.

meta.whenToUse: A short fixed-length verification code — 2FA/MFA, email/SMS OTP.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free-form/variable-length text (Input) or a single masked secret (Password Input).
